Competition for this acquisition is RESTRICTED TO SMALL BUSINESSES. AN OFFEROR MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE REGISTRATION IN THE SYSTEM FORAWARD MANAGEMENT WHEN PLACING AN OFFER/QUOTATION PACKAGE FORTHIS ACQUISITION. REGISTRATION CAN BE COMPLETED FREE OF CHARGE ATwww.sam.gov. SUBMITTAL DUE DATE AND TIME: The Contractor submittal packages must be received by the USACE-Chicago District Office no later than 1:00 p.m. (Central Time) on September 18, 2024.
